import sys,io
sys.path.insert(0,'deps');sys.path.insert(0,'submission')
import zstandard as zstd
from classify_responses import complete_frames,decompress_zstd
from common import CaptureError,MAX_WINDOW
c=zstd.ZstdCompressor(write_content_size=False);d=bytearray(c.compress(b'hello world'))
# window descriptor at index5 flag0; exponent17 -> window 2^27
d[5]=(17<<3)|0
try:
 p=zstd.get_frame_parameters(bytes(d));print('win',p.window_size,MAX_WINDOW)
 complete_frames(bytes(d));print('frames ok')
 x=decompress_zstd(bytes(d),MAX_WINDOW);print('decomp',x)
except CaptureError as e:print('cap err',e)
except Exception as e:print('ERR',type(e),e)
